values.note: No entrance fee. The park's parking tag is not needed for a vehicle parked at its own campsite, only for extra vehicles or parking elsewhere in the park.

values.note: Check in at the campground office on arrival; arriving after hours, check in by noon the next day or the reservation counts as a no-show.

season.source: https://developer.nps.gov/api/v1/campgrounds?parkCode=grsm (operating hours: 'Cades Cove Campground is open year-round. Loop B and parts of Loop C are open from mid-spring through Nov. 30. During the winter, only sites C1-12 and C26-61 are open'), read 2026-11-24

note: In the Cades Cove valley of Great Smoky Mountains National Park. Generators may run in Loop B outside 8 p.m.-8 a.m.; Loop C is generator-free while Loop B is open. Some accessible sites have a 5-amp outlet for medical equipment only. The trailer limit is 35 ft; sites C45, C51, C53 and C70 are under 23 ft. --Claude
summary: NPS campground confirmed: year-round (winter: C1-12, C26-61 only), reservation-only on rec.gov, $30, no hookups/showers, flush toilets, water, dump (new), seasonal store; 161 sites (stored 159), RV 40/trailer 35 ft. Parking tag not needed at the campsite (fee fact only, not counted for the gate). Phone 865-436-1200 -> 865-448-4103.
flags: PHONE 865-436-1200 (park headquarters) -> 865-448-4103 (recreation.gov: 'Please call (865) 448-4103 for general information'). The NPS API lists (865) 448-2472 ext. 2 for the campground. Websites unchanged.

PARKING TAG (fee fact, not counted for the price gate): rec.gov 'Front country campers parked at their designated campsite will not be required to have a parking tag'; needed only for vehicles beyond the site's allowance or parked elsewhere in the park. Written into fees.note.

SITES: 161 overnight sites (NPS totalSites 161, rec.gov catalog 161; stored 159), 31 of them tent-only; 127 take an RV, trailer or fifth wheel and 123 of those are 23 ft or more. Four RV-permitted sites are under 23 ft (C45 15, C51 20, C53 20, C70 21).

Status operating; season year_round confirmed by the NPS statement (stored value was derived). Pin matches NPS's own (35.60272,-83.77629). Not waterfront (unchanged). No policy-row contradiction: NPS fees are untaxed as the federal:nps row says; the 6-month window matches.
